skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the concept, characteristics, and structure of public assets and their role in the economy.
Grasp the basic theories and practices of managing public assets in administrative and infrastructure sectors.
Understand the financial management of specific assets such as land, resources, and state-owned assets.
Learn the valuation methods for public assets and land.
Understand the organizational structure and principles of public asset management.
Apply critical thinking to evaluate issues in public asset management.
Conduct research, analyze, and synthesize information to evaluate public asset management issues.
Manage financial aspects of public assets.
Understand and comply with legal regulations related to public asset management.
Analyze policies related to public asset management.
Apply economic principles to public asset management.
Collaborate effectively in group projects and presentations.
Deliver effective presentations on public asset management topics.
Manage time effectively to complete assignments and prepare for exams.
